title: Patch: a stolen permanent with no room on the thief's side is destroyed, past Indestructible and Untributable
notes: R4205000: a steal of a card on the field that finds no room for it on the thief's side (no free zone in its row, R15; no fit for a GIGA, R3546003) destroys it instead, and nothing prevents that destroy: not Indestructible (R46), not Untributable (R1220), no would-die replacement; a destroy-to-exile aura still exiles it (R1849002), its Death and Reborn apply and it goes to its controller's graveyard (R2618000). StealOtherwise and StealTarget.otherwise are gone, every steal now destroying so. #49's and M #97.4's Radiant 'make it Radiant' lands only on a card the steal took, through steal's new `radiant` option (R282). Give control (R803) and cards no steal reaches are unchanged. A replay of a game with such a steal folds to another state and is refused as rules_changed (R767000).

player.title: A steal with no room destroys the card
changes: Stealing a card when your side has no room for it now destroys it, even if it is Indestructible or Untributable.
That card's Death still happens, Reborn still brings it back on its own side, and it goes to its own player's graveyard.
Snom Bunny Mind Control and Mega Church make a card Radiant only when they take it.
